segments.name: Event Management
segments.description: Provides customized event management and stage production services, including event design, logistics and installations, to customers in Hong Kong.
segments.evidence: The Company operated during the fiscal years presented as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay fixed transaction prices for customized event management services and for stage production goods and installation; all revenue comes from third parties in Hong Kong.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company provides customized event management services upon requests from its customers in exchange for a fixed transaction price.
